description: This file contains test cases for functions related to handling 'allow-from' logic, including merging sources, resolving group allowlists, and checking sender ID permissions. It uses the Vitest testing framework and references functions from a local module 'allow-from.js'.

methods.name: mergeDmAllowFromSources
methods.description: Merges and filters 'allowFrom' and 'storeAllowFrom' lists, optionally considering 'dmPolicy'.

methods.name: resolveGroupAllowFromSources
methods.description: Resolves group allowlist, falling back to DM allowlist unless disabled.

methods.name: firstDefined
methods.description: Returns the first argument that is not undefined.

methods.name: isSenderIdAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a sender ID or wildcard is permitted based on entries and channel context.

ctags.name: name
ctags.pattern: /^      name: "keeps pairing-store entries for non-allowlist policies",$/
